Typeface note: the design chose Libre Franklin, but the @fontsource/libre-franklin 5.3.0 latin files have no
'tnum' (tabular figures) feature, so per the design doc (section 7) the site uses Public Sans, Libre Franklin's
tabular-figure derivative, as its single family.
